title: Boarded Up Released
author: Alexguitar11
selftext:
Hello ive been working on an isometric zombie survival game lately and i have released it on [itch.io](http://itch.io) for pc and mobile is coming soon hopefully. I am waiting to get more testers as google now requires a 14 day closed loop test. Anyways heres my [itch.io](http://itch.io) link if you are interested!

[https://alexguitar11.itch.io/boarded-up](https://alexguitar11.itch.io/boarded-up)

comments.author: ShrimpAU
comments.body:
Congrats on the release.

But man, I've been working on a similar looking and seemingly playing zombie game like this for months at this point.  I started with a huge design doc and brief for all my ideas and things, thinking I was making my own original take on something, and it seems all my ideas were completely unoriginal xD.

Half way through development I looked into Project Zomboid as well, since I'd never played or seen anything about it, and immediately felt like I was ripping it off because it shared so many ideas.

Feels like when I get to release my thing it's going to be so derivative it'll instantly be shut down as copycat slop ;_;

---

Any chance of a Linux build?

There's also a directory in your demo download called `BoardedUp_BackUpThisFolder_ButDontShipItWithYourGame` which you might want to remove.

replies.author: Alexguitar11
replies.body:
Dang I'm sorry to hear that. Yes I had inspiration from Project zomboid but I wanted this to be targeted towards a mobile game something simpler and and easy to play without having to learn a bunch of game mechanics just play and have fun but I can't even get 12 testers the publish on the Play Store so I decided to Port it over to PC. Oh crap I didn't realize that was in there gonna have to re-upload lol. I will see about Linux.
I've had alot of free time. I've spent 100 hours on it just this week alone.
